caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display over a yellow-lit building, where red lanterns hang along the facade and a person in the foreground holds a smartphone up to the sky. A large spherical aerial burst of white and pink radial streaks already glows in the upper-left-center, its outer trails slowly dimming and drooping. Along the roofline, fan-shaped ground fireworks spread outward, first as bright white plumes, then with pink-tipped streaks fanning up. These fountains gradually elongate into near-vertical trails topped by green-white heads as the pink tips recede. Smoke swirls and thickens across the sky, tinted by the bursts. To the lower left of the main burst, a second smaller pinkish sphere blooms and expands into a chrysanthemum pattern. The dark balloon at the left edge and the red lanterns remain stationary, while the handheld framing drifts slowly, nudging the building a little leftward.
